Build an Eligible-Group Roster From Precision-Evaluated Support

Source: R/profile_eligibility.R
profile_define_cohort.Rd

The function that was missing from the J2-L history: takes the pass/fail table from profile_plan_precision and actually decides which groups (hospitals, ...) are in, producing both the roster vector and a traceable manifest – replacing a hand-typed list with a real, reproducible, data-derived decision.

Usage

profile_define_cohort(
  thresholds,
  min_tier = "tier2",
  estimands = c("class", "pair", "profile"),
  mode = c("all", "complete_case")
)

Arguments

thresholds

Output of profile_plan_precision (the list form, with $class/$pair/$profile).

min_tier

Character. Which passes_<tier> column must be TRUE – one of the names used in tiers when profile_plan_precision was run (e.g. "tier1", "tier2", ...). Default "tier2" (the middle of the default three-tier set, tier1=5/tier2=7.5/tier3=10 points).

estimands

Character vector, any of "class", "pair", "profile". A group must pass min_tier on every requested estimand, for every class/pair/the profile, to be included. Default all three (the strictest, most defensible choice – narrow this explicitly if e.g. only class margins matter for a given use).

mode

Character, "all" or "complete_case". Recorded in the manifest only – this function does not itself subset event-level data; it documents which cohort definition the roster is meant for.

Value

A list:

roster

character vector of included group names

manifest

data frame, one row per group, with a logical included column and a reason string naming the first failing estimand/class when excluded
